import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Twin prime conjecture

*References:*
- [Landau Problems Wikipedia Page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Landau%27s_problems#Twin_prime_conjecture)
- [Twin Primes Conjecture Wikipedia Page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twin_prime#Twin_prime_conjecture)
-/


namespace TwinPrimes

/--
Are there infinitely many primes p such that p + 2 is prime?
-/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem twin_primes :
    answer(sorry) ↔ {p : ℕ | Prime p ∧ Prime (p + 2)}.Infinite := by
  sorry

end TwinPrimes

Local Mathlib: Mathlib/Data/Finite/Defs.lean and Mathlib/Order/Interval/Finset/Basic.lean (Set.Infinite and its unboundedness characterization).

The answer has the correct propositional type, scope, and polarity. Both sources still describe the conjecture as unresolved, consistent with research open.
